recorte: residentes do Nordeste, conforme tabela tratada usada no relatorio

notificacao_dengue_ne.consulta_sql: SELECT * FROM public.notificacao_dengue_ne WHERE ano BETWEEN 2000 AND 2025 ORDER BY id

populacao_municipio_ano.consulta_sql: SELECT p.* FROM public.populacao_municipio_ano p JOIN public.municipio m USING (cod_mun7) WHERE p.ano BETWEEN 2000 AND 2025 AND m.uf_cod BETWEEN 21 AND 29 ORDER BY p.cod_mun7,p.ano

populacao_ne.consulta_sql: SELECT * FROM public.populacao_ne WHERE ano BETWEEN 2000 AND 2025 AND uf_cod BETWEEN 21 AND 29 ORDER BY cod_mun7,ano

municipio_ne.consulta_sql: SELECT * FROM public.municipio WHERE uf_cod BETWEEN 21 AND 29 ORDER BY cod_mun7

estado_ne.consulta_sql: SELECT * FROM public.estado WHERE uf_cod BETWEEN 21 AND 29 ORDER BY uf_cod

consulta_resumo_anual:
SELECT ano, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE caso_provavel),
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE caso_confirmado), count(*) FILTER (WHERE possivel_duplicata),
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE idade_anos IS NULL),
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(btrim(sexo), '') IS NULL),
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE mes_sintomas IS NULL)
                FROM public.notificacao_dengue_ne WHERE ano BETWEEN 2000 AND 2025
                GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano
